question: 11² + 12² + 13² + dots + 45² = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Sum of squares formula = n(n+1)(2n+1) ÷ 6

Required Sum = (Sum from 1 to 45) − (Sum from 1 to 10)

Sum = [(45 × 46 × 91) ÷ 6] − [(10 × 11 × 21) ÷ 6]

Sum = 31395 − 385 = 31010

**∴ The correct answer is 31010.**
